recommendation.root_tuning: Keep all voice root centers unchanged. The free-tail modal fit recovers nominal frequency. Fixed correction from four windows harms heldout WOOD and BRUSH performance across every tested octave.
recommendation.tine_upper_mode: Move strongest upper ratio from5.96 to6.00; preserves nominal root and improves heldout short-window pitch scores acrossC2–C5.
recommendation.limits: C2 one wrong-register detector result persists; perceived tuning during impacts remains for owner listening. These windows use one fixed event/roughness history and velocity; no claim of full macro/seed coverage.
